courses.title: History of the U.S. Since 1877
courses.course_description: This class explores how the United States attained economic and military power, and what it did with that power at home and abroad. It covers the Gilded Age, Progressivism, the U.S.’s role in two world wars, the Cold War, the Civil Rights movement, the societal transformation of the 1960s and 1970s, the Reagan and Clinton eras, and the United States in the early years of the new millennium.
